authorization: one temporary beta window only; no new image
statistics_method: Vehicle counts per REST snapshot. Percentages pooled over repeated vehicle observations. Ages median of snapshot medians/p90, not pooled physical GPS percentiles. Steady includes fallback after first joint composition+30s.
trace_scope: 898 only; no fleet-wide exact per-source CAS/REST/SignalR counters
limitations: Short sequential before/during/after comparison, no simultaneous GTFS-only counterfactual.
Only 898 has exact backend cohort tracing; no exact ITS fleet-wide publication count by source.
Capture completeness means logs retained and acquisitions reconciled, not every acquisition successful.
Supervisor persistent HTTP deadline starts at first observation error; startup sampling detection lag is measured separately.
No proof about historical 48.6s acquisition cause beyond present measured network/body and pending waits.
